answer.summary: Loads all discount group interest rate definitions from the DISCGRP file into in-memory arrays for subsequent calculation use. It constructs a composite key from group, type, and category fields and stores the corresponding annual interest rate.

rules.text: Sets end-of-file flag SW_EOF_DSC to '1'B when the DISCGRP file is exhausted.
Increments the index ZS_N by 1 for each record read.
Constructs the composite key ZS_SCHL by concatenating DSC_GRP, DSC_TYP, and DSC_KAT.
Stores the annual interest rate DSC_ZINS into the ZS_P array at the current index.
